channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Editorial | An ICE pause is the only path to peace
item.description: It’s not debatable after the latest fatal shooting.

item.title: Agents detain and send 2-year-old girl and her father to Texas despite court order to release toddler
item.description: Attorneys for the family say they were asylum-seekers who were pulled over without a warrant. The girl has since been reunited with her mother.

item.title: Senate Democratic opposition to DHS funding raises the stakes on partial government shutdown
item.description: Both of Minnesota’s Democratic senators plan to vote against the funding.

item.title: Timberwolves’ game against Warriors at Target Center postponed to Sunday
item.description: The NBA said the decision was made to prioritize the safety and security of the Minneapolis community.

item.title: Justice Department warns of ‘copy cat raiders’ as it seeks more arrests for St. Paul church protest
item.description: An appeals court denies DOJ’s request for emergency arrests of church protesters.

item.title: Class action lawsuit filed against federal operation targeting Minnesota’s legal refugees
item.description: Operation PARRIS is detaining the state’s new refugees for “re-examination” at the same time as the federal crackdown on illegal immigration.

item.title: Violent crime is down in Minneapolis, but police overtime is up amid ICE surge
item.description: The department logged about $3 million in overtime for five days in which officers’ days off had to be canceled.

item.title: ‘Not a cheap piece of crap’: Gun reportedly carried by Alex Pretti is widely popular among enthusiasts
item.description: The customized firearm appeared to be a version of the Sig Sauer P320, a 9mm pistol carried by law enforcement and U.S. military members.

item.title: ‘He was only helping’: Witness accounts of shooting shared in bid to get ICE restrictions reinstated
item.description: A pediatrician at the scene said they saw no agents performing CPR.

item.title: The latest: Minnesota reels after second fatal shooting by federal agents
item.description: Protesters gathered at a park near where a man was shot and killed by federal agents Saturday. Federal officials say the man was armed.
